title: Schedule
name: Name
error: Unable to save or load the schedule. Check the fields and try again.
conflict: This record changed or is in use. Reload before trying again.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view the schedule.
timeHelp: Times use the gym timezone. Times skipped by daylight saving are unavailable; repeated times use the first occurrence.
templateHelp: Weekly classes generate sessions nightly, eight weeks ahead. Edits apply to dates that have not been generated. Existing sessions keep their details and overrides.
deleteTemplateConfirm: Delete this weekly class? Existing sessions and attendance will be kept.
moved: Session moved. Its bookings and attendance moved with it.
occupied: Another session of this weekly class already starts at exactly this time. Choose a different start time.
invalidTime: That time doesn't exist in the gym timezone (clocks change that day). Choose another time.
moveHelp: Changes apply to this session only. Its bookings and attendance stay with it, and its weekly class won't create it again at the old time.
editHelp: Changes apply to this session only. Its bookings and attendance stay with it.
loadFailed: The schedule couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
emptyFiltered: No sessions match these filters this week.
emptyHelp: Add a weekly class to fill the calendar, or add a one-off session.
noTemplatesHelp: Weekly classes fill the calendar automatically. Use New weekly class to add one.
